content.title: About
content.content: Rice, fried, with chicken is a popular Asian dish consisting of boiled rice stir‑fried with pieces of chicken, vegetables and soy sauce. The dish offers a fragrant flavor, combining tender chicken with the subtle sweetness of rice.

content.title: Interesting Facts
items: The dish is often cooked in a wok, allowing quick high‑heat stir‑frying of the ingredients.
In China there are many regional variations, where shrimp, beef or tofu replace the chicken.
Traditional recipes add thin strips of scrambled egg for extra taste and texture.
It is commonly garnished with sliced green onions and toasted sesame seeds.
Because it is fast and nutritious, it is a staple in cafeterias and street‑food stalls.

items.title: Source of protein
items.content: Chicken provides high‑quality protein essential for tissue growth and repair.

items.title: Energy supply
items.content: Rice delivers carbohydrates that are quickly converted into energy.

items.title: B‑vitamins
items.content: The dish contains vitamin B6 and niacin, supporting metabolism and nervous system function.

items.title: Minerals
items.content: It supplies iron, phosphorus and potassium, important for blood formation and electrolyte balance.

items.title: Low in saturated fat
items.content: When prepared with moderate amounts of vegetable oil, the dish remains relatively low in saturated fats.

items.title: Chicken allergy
items.content: Some individuals may experience allergic reactions to chicken.

items.title: Sodium content
items.content: Soy sauce and added salt can increase sodium intake, which is a concern for hypertension.

items.title: Foodborne infection risk
items.content: Undercooked chicken may harbor salmonella; ensure it is cooked thoroughly.

items.title: High glycemic index
items.content: White rice can cause rapid blood‑sugar spikes, so people with diabetes should monitor portion size.

content.title: How to Eat
content.content: Serve the dish hot, often accompanied by soy sauce, chili sauce or a splash of vinegar. You can add fresh vegetables such as carrots, peas or bell pepper, and sprinkle with toasted sesame seeds and chopped green onions.

content.title: Storage
content.content: Store leftovers in an airtight container in the refrigerator for up to 2‑3 days. When reheating, make sure the dish reaches an internal temperature of at least 75 °C to eliminate any possible bacteria.
